title: Learned OT traffic model
description: The model file written by `ot-learn`: for every industrial device, who talked to it, with which functions, how often and when.

version.description: Version of the model layout; ot-listen refuses a newer one.

source.description: The capture file or interface it was learned from.

first.description: Time of the first learned message, Unix seconds.

last.description: Time of the last learned message, Unix seconds.

assets.description: Device address to its model: protocols, first, last, events, peers (client address to events, first, last and the functions it used), functions (`Protocol: function` to count and control), hours and control_hours (24 values each, UTC), active_minutes and max_per_minute.
